text:
ash: quick flag from quant4b-canary: small but repeatable BLEU/exec differences on the synthesis promptset after the dedupe-sweep. can we triage?

meenal: numbers?

ash: on the 200-sample synthesis micro-golden: BLEU -2.7, exact-snippet-match -1.4, exec-success -0.8. concentrated on examples with appended clarifying lines.

tom: which dedupe job ran? we had fuzzymerge_production v1.7 last night.

lucy (label-ops): checking history now. fuzzymerge_production@2026-03-14T02:12 collapsed 63 rows in the synthesis bank. 19 of those were previously annotated as gold variants.

ash: any ids we can look at?

lucy (label-ops): synth-gld-5123, synth-gld-5124, synth-gld-5150. they were merged into synth-gld-5123. labelers had different final outputs before.

meenal: hypothesis: dedupe merged trailing clarifying lines that change the expected assistant behavior. quant4b kernel remap may amplify that. need to isolate.

bench-bot: queued short qbench: qbench-3890012345-quant4b-diff (micro-golden subset). est 9m. link: https://ci.internal/runs/3890012345

ash: while that runs, lucy can you restore the three merged anchors in a fork and we can re-run pinned eval?

lucy (label-ops): creating fork now. command: 
```
python infra/tools/fork_goldset.py --source synthesis-goldset --restore synth-ids-restore.txt --out synthesis-goldset-restore-63
```
ops: fork uploaded s3://goldsets/synthesis-goldset-restore-63 (size: 420MB)

ci-bot: qbench-3890012345-quant4b-diff complete. merged-set: BLEU -2.7, exact -1.4.

bench-bot: queued second run: qbench-3890012345-quant4b-restore (pinned to synthesis-goldset-restore-63). link: https://ci.internal/runs/3890012358

meenal: also note quant4b changed attention scaling slightly in the auto-quantizer; that may interact with dropped trailing tokens. isolating dedupe first makes sense.

bench-bot: qbench-3890012345-quant4b-restore complete. restored-set: BLEU -0.3, exact -0.1, exec +0.0.

ash: good repro - merge is main contributor.

lucy (label-ops): proposal: add gold flag `preserve_trailing` for anchors where trailing lines contain clarifiers. heuristic: if sample contains tokens matching regex `^Clarify:|^Follow-up:|^Assistant note:` mark preserve_trailing=true. I'll backfill ~210 anchors across synthesis+codegen.

tom: +1. Also add a dedupe pipeline rule to skip merges when preserve_trailing==true OR metadata.labeler_variants_count > 1. open a small PR with tests.

lucy (label-ops): PR opened: https://git.internal/p/dedupe/pull/215. includes unit tests for the regex heuristic and an e2e smoke running the micro-golden diff.

meenal: for onboarding gates, require quantized bring-ups to run a micro-golden delta focused on `preserve_trailing` flagged anchors and abort promotion if exact_match delta < -1%.

ash: I'll add that to the onboarding checklist and hold the quant4b canary until PR merges and gate is in CI. tagging release board. :no_entry_sign:

lucy (label-ops): I'll start manual review for the top 60 fused merges in synthesis; ETA: 36h for top-20, 96h for full 60.

tom: ops: snapshot commit and goldset before we accept any further dedupe runs. need provenance for audit.

ci-bot: snapshot created: repo@commit:7b4e1cf; goldset_s3: s3://goldsets/snapshots/3890012345-7b4e1cf.tar.gz

ash: thanks all. good catch. if anyone sees other drift across promptsets ping here and we'll escalate.

meenal: thanks team. small metadata change but high impact. :white_check_mark:
